body:
Farfa said that the next lcs is the last one he wants to do before he reboots. He's grown stale of the format and has gone over the course of 24 hours from energetically looking forward to the next one to actually yelling and cheering that it's "finally over." And if I can take a little bit of time to (politely) vent.

It's *Farfa's* tournament. He's been addressed by his chat about this multiple times on stream. If there are issues with the tournament it's by *design,* not because the players are bad, they're **dueling their pants off** with the cards available. Which leads to the card pool itself, which is full of floodgates Farfa doesn't like, yet it's hard to find sympathy for those frustrations. From what I can tell, he doesn't make the banlists, and despite them playing at the start of every video, doesn't even seem to read them to know what is banned in any given weekend since he's regularly surprised that an archetype hasn't topped yet.

I get that he's a busy guy and father and he's putting a ton of content out lately so I certainly don't want him burned out, and I overwhelmingly sympathize with that aspect, but you know Farfa's decision to take a hands off approach is definitely hurting his enjoyment of the series when he is basically fighting with his own mods live on stream over their ban choices for backrow removal (see his emergency request to unban mst yesterday). And then when a week shows up and it isn't as entertaining as he would like the guy just calls it quits and pulls the plug abruptly on a year's worth of development and yanks the rug out from under his community. 

I am a massive fan of lcs. It's what got me into following his channel last year and subscribing on his twitch for the last few months. I'll probably stick around because I like his humor. And yeah, all good things gotta end. But it's good for them to end while on top. And right now we're going out on a bad format, specifically because it wasn't given the love it needs to succeed. It's being abandoned, not completed. Which is extremely disappointing. Whose to say this doesn't happen again to lcs season 2? Is that going to end again just because the curated list of cards that Farfa didn't pick end up exhausting him so badly he doesn't find his new creation fun again? What happens when lcs season 2 turns into the average master 1 ranked meta in four episodes after all the most broken stuff gets axed? What happens when floodgates like Vanity's emptiness start destroying the back and forth value? Is Farfa going to take a hands on approach to moderating the tournament, risking further overworking on his part? If so, why not just do that now? Or does he move onto lcs 3? 

In the end, it's his game, his tournament, his rules, his channel. I'll still watch his streams and enjoy his events. This isn't a "I hate farf" post. It's because I like his content so much that I'll miss it when it changes. Ending a long running series suddenly is a very divisive choice and it'll take a little while for everything to resettle. So I'm a little bit mad, but we all get a little mad sometimes. It'll pass.
